title.zh: SmartLingo 已验证付款方式页面迁移

purpose.zh: 直接迁移 SmartMeeting 已验证的独立付款方式选择页，让 Max 与 AIGC 额度包明确显示 Stripe 信用卡、美国银行账户及 SmartPay5 加密货币付款。
purpose.en: Directly migrate the verified SmartMeeting standalone payment-method chooser so Max and AIGC credit packs clearly expose Stripe card, US bank-account, and SmartPay5 crypto payment.

zh: 沿用已在 SmartMeeting 与 Mahj 验证的双机密部署模式，在发布前要求 Stripe API 密钥与 Webhook 签名密钥同时存在。
新增签名校验的 Stripe Checkout Webhook，处理成功、异步成功、异步失败和过期事件，并复用现有统一权益入账逻辑。
GitHub Actions 将两个加密机密同步到 SmartLingo 的 Cloudflare Worker；Stripe 托管 Checkout 不添加域名白名单。
价格卡片现在进入从 SmartMeeting 迁移的独立付款方式页面；页面明确分开 Stripe 信用卡/美国银行账户与 SmartPay5 加密货币，并支持全部界面语言。
en: Reuse the dual-secret deployment pattern verified on SmartMeeting and Mahj, requiring both the Stripe API key and webhook signing secret before release.
Add a signature-verified Stripe Checkout webhook for completed, asynchronous success, asynchronous failure, and expired events while reusing the existing unified entitlement fulfillment.
Synchronize both encrypted GitHub secrets to the SmartLingo Cloudflare Worker; Stripe-hosted Checkout does not add a payment-method domain allowlist.
Pricing cards now enter the standalone payment-method page migrated from SmartMeeting; it clearly separates Stripe card/US bank account from SmartPay5 crypto and supports every interface language.

zh: Max 6 个月与 12 个月、1,000 AIGC 额度包、Stripe Checkout、GitHub Actions、Cloudflare Worker 运行时机密和付款入账。
en: Six- and twelve-month Max, the 1,000-credit AIGC pack, Stripe Checkout, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Worker runtime secrets, and payment fulfillment.

zh: 结账入口在两个 Stripe 机密均可用时才开放，防止只能创建订单却无法接收可靠付款结果的半配置状态。
Webhook 对原始请求体做 HMAC-SHA256 签名校验、五分钟时间窗校验、事件幂等处理，以及商品、用户、金额和币种的服务端核对。
失败或过期的 Checkout 会关闭相应待付款意图；成功付款仍复用既有 Max 延期与 AIGC 额度账本，不新增权益分支。
en: Expose checkout only when both Stripe secrets are available, preventing a partially configured state that can create orders without reliable payment-result delivery.
Verify webhook raw-body HMAC-SHA256 signatures within a five-minute tolerance, process events idempotently, and validate the product, user, amount, and currency server-side.
Close failed or expired checkout intents and keep successful payments on the existing Max-extension and AIGC-credit ledgers without adding a new entitlement branch.

zh: 自动化测试覆盖 Stripe 签名正确、签名篡改和过期拒绝，以及工作流双机密同步与四类 Checkout 事件。
TypeScript、零警告 ESLint、完整测试、敏感数据扫描与生产构建必须在发布前通过。
生产部署后将以登录测试用户创建 Stripe 托管 Checkout Session 并核对商品与金额，但不会提交真实付款。
en: Automated tests cover valid Stripe signatures, tampered and stale signature rejection, dual-secret workflow synchronization, and all four Checkout event types.
TypeScript, zero-warning ESLint, the full test suite, sensitive-data scanning, and the production build must pass before release.
After production deployment, a signed-in test user will create a hosted Stripe Checkout Session to verify the product and amount without submitting a live payment.

zh: 本次不代表用户确认任何真实 Stripe 收款；真实付款验证由站点所有者在其付款凭证控制下另行完成。
en: This release does not confirm a live Stripe charge for the user; the site owner retains control of any real-payment validation.

zh: 保持 SmartLingo 现有一次性固定期限 Max 与预付 AIGC 额度模型；不引入自动续费，也不复制其他站点的机密。
en: Keep the existing SmartLingo one-time fixed-term Max and prepaid AIGC credit model, with no automatic renewal and no credential copied from another site.

rollback.zh: 回退到上一成功的 Cloudflare Worker 即可恢复旧接口；已有付款意图、Max 权益与 AIGC 额度账本不删除。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare Worker to restore the prior API behavior; do not delete checkout intents, Max entitlements, or AIGC credit ledger entries.
